Private gRPC client state, stream pool, and HTTP/2 callback declarations.

# Purpose
This header defines the private data structures and internal helper functions for the gRPC client implementation. It declares `fd_grpc_h2_stream_t`, which stores per-stream state such as request context, response header buffers, message buffers, and timeout fields, and it also defines a pool for managing these stream objects. The `fd_grpc_client_private` structure holds the full client state, including the HTTP/2 connection, TLS status, stream maps, buffers, authority data, version data, and metrics pointer. The file also declares internal functions for stream acquisition, stream release, stream servicing, and HTTP/2 header callbacks used by the client.
